## What's new

**Installers for every platform Electron reaches.** The release page now covers Windows x64 and arm64 (installer + portable zip each), adds an Intel x64 dmg for macOS next to the arm64 one, and ships Linux x64/arm64 in all four formats (AppImage, deb, rpm, tar.gz). Two cross-build degradations, stated plainly. ## What's new

**Undo for applied proposals.** Approving an AI proposal is now a commit you can revert. Every applied proposal card carries a small Undo button (with a confirm step to prevent slips); clicking it restores the learning state captured just before the apply — lesson progress, per-knowledge-component mastery, SRS scheduling, the learner profile — and claws back the XP that apply awarded, without touching XP you earned afterwards. Undos work in any order; if new learning records landed on top

## What's new

**A new app icon, everywhere.** The letter-L artwork got a higher-impact composition (the glyph now fills about 60% of the canvas instead of 45%), redrawn at 2048px, and shipped across every installer: Windows, macOS, Linux, the Android launcher, and the web/PWA icons. Android launchers crop icons into circles and other masks, and the new glyph would have poked out of them — so the launcher foreground is auto-fitted into the mask safe zone by a script (`scripts/generate-brand-icons.mjs`).
